description: Build reusable DoxieOS libraries (memory packs) under .doxie/libraries/<id>/. Subcommands - `from-files` ingests N source files, `from-current` snapshots the running workspace's memories, `interactive` walks the user through authoring. The skill validates args, builds a JSON input, and dispatches the `library` agent (a leaf worker) which is the only writer to disk. Output is always a folder containing one library.json manifest plus N memory .md files with valid YAML frontmatter.

fields.label: Intro prompt
fields.placeholder: Library of .NET conventions used across the organization client projects; consumer is a dev bootstrapping a new repo.

from-files.description: Synthesise a new library from arbitrary source files or directories. Folders are walked recursively for .md and .txt files. Provide an intro prompt to bias classification and naming.

fields.label: Intro prompt
fields.placeholder: Snapshot of my preferred tooling defaults for a fresh workspace.

from-current.description: Snapshot the running workspace's auto-memory directory into a reusable library. Optional intro prompt biases the manifest description.
